detail.title: GP310R Wireless Gamepad with Neon RGB - D-Input & X-Input
detail.overview: The Ant Esports GP310R is a wireless gamepad built for gamers who don't want a cable holding them back, using a 2.4GHz USB dongle for lag-free, plug-and-play performance across Windows, PS3 and Android 4.0+ devices (OTG adapter required for Android). Its transparent ABS shell houses dual vibration motors under the joysticks, delivering timely tactile feedback that adds a layer of immersion beyond a standard wired pad. An 800mAh battery keeps it running for up to 12 hours of continuous play, and the ergonomically shaped shell stays comfortable and breathable through marathon gaming sessions. Supporting both D-Input and X-Input modes for Windows, it's a flexible, cable-free upgrade for PC and compatible console setups.
